corrections.text: The article describes Packagist's change only as making stable versions immutable and advises tagging a new version. The documentation template it cites also gives maintainers a takedown route: "Maintainers can soft-delete a version they own from the package page" (hidden from Composer metadata, recoverable by the maintainer), while "Administrator takedowns (for malware, abuse, or legal reasons) cannot be recovered by maintainers".
